hardware: NVIDIA GB10 (SM121), 128 GB unified memory; CUDA 13.0
software: Torch 2.13.0+cu130, SGLang 0.5.21, Transformers 5.12.1, Triton 3.7.1, CuTe DSL 4.8.0
protocol: sglang-candidates; one engine at a time on one GB10; a warm-up pass, then one recorded pass. ScopeJudge: 1,043 single questions. JEV-format requests: 645 requests with 1-3 questions (1,068 labelled questions) and 9 synthetic requests with 4, 8 and 16 questions on short, medium and long conversations. Serial arms score each question with score(); the batch arm scores single questions with score() and multi-question requests with score_batch(), with the cache kept across requests. Reference latency excludes the cache clears.
decision: argmax candidate (ScopeJudge, choice), P(yes) >= 0.5 (noul), most probable legend key (score)
